items.label: ✔️ Space-Saving and Convenient
items.value: This couch arm table fits snugly at the edge of your sofa, keeping snacks and drinks within easy reach while you relax. Simply flip it up 90° when not in use—effortless and hassle-free!

items.label: ✔️ Easily Adjustable Height Levels
items.value: The sofa table offers 9 height settings, adjustable from 19 to 30 inches, letting you customize it perfectly for eating, working, or relaxing.

items.label: ✔️ Size Upgrade
items.value: Featuring a 16" x 12" enlarged panel, thicker upright posts, and a wider metal base, this couch tray ensures greater capacity and rock-solid stability.

items.label: ✔️Easy to Assemble
items.value: Designed for all ages, this sofa armrest table is ideal for laptops, books, and drinks while seamlessly complementing your living room decor. A thoughtful gift for housewarming, birthdays, or Christmas!

items.label: ✔️Versatile TV Tray table
items.value: Whether as a TV dinner tray, coffee table, snack table, bed table, reading table, study desk , or a portable workstation, this TV Tray table adapts to all your needs—your ultimate multi-tasking hero!
